title: a release whose comment GitHub refused, and whose read of the issue's comments after it GitHub refused too, puts the labels back beside a comment that may stand, which holds the claim for good
status: fixed after 0.4.1: a run that cannot read the issue's comments to tell whether a release comment stands, whatever GitHub answered its own with, leaves the labels as the release left them and counts no release of its own, and the next run settles it as it settles any claim whose labels are off, while on a head a release already kept the earlier release frees the claim in that run (github.release_one, github.unsettled; DESIGN.md, 13)

steps.note: a's claim has had no commit for 25 hours, so the coordinator releases it: the labels come off, GitHub writes the release comment and answers 502, then refuses the read of the issue's comments that would show it, so the run cannot tell whether the comment stands; it leaves the labels as the release left them, counts no release and renames nothing, and the page lists the claim as held. Until the fix the labels went back beside the comment that stands, which held the claim for good: the comment told every later coordinator the claim was released, and the label claimed told the board it was held
the next run reads the comment GitHub wrote, counts the release and renames the branch, so #1 is in the Queue again; b's claim, idle 24 hours, is held

b's claim has had no commit for 25 hours: GitHub refuses the release comment, having written nothing, and the read of the issue's comments after it, so again the run leaves the labels as the release left them and counts no release
the next run finds no release comment on #2 and releases the claim again, its labels already off counting as taken off, then renames the branch
a pushes its released head again as claude/1, a head a release kept
and puts the label claimed back, which undoes the release: the earlier release comment counts for a kept head whenever it came, but not beside the label claimed
the board lists a's claim as held again

a's head has gone a day since its push, so the coordinator releases the claim again: GitHub refuses the release comment, having written nothing, and the read after it, so the run counts no release of its own; but the head is one a release kept, whose earlier comment counts for it once the label claimed is off, so the same run lists the claim as released and deletes claude/1, whose work released/1 keeps, and no comment of this release is on the issue (F20's review)
the next run has nothing to settle: claude/1 is gone and the release stands, with no word of its own
b claims #2 again, from the Queue

b's new claim has had no commit for 25 hours: GitHub refuses the release comment with a 422, having written nothing, and then the read of the issue's comments after it, so the run cannot read whether a release comment that someone else wrote, or that GitHub wrote for an earlier run and lists only later, stands; it leaves the labels as the release left them and counts no release, as after a server error (F23's review). F20's mutant, a refused read taken for one that lists none, puts the labels back here, where since F23's fix it does what the library does after the server errors at steps 8 and 10
the next run finds no release comment on #2 newer than b's claim and releases it again, its labels already off counting as taken off, then renames the branch
